package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for http_handler_missing_security_headers: HTTP handler functions that write responses without setting `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, or `Content-Security-Policy` headers (or without security header middleware)
// fixture polarity: positive; family: security; severity: warning.
func handlerDashboard(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	type Dashboard struct {
		User    string `json:"user"`
		Revenue int    `json:"revenue"`
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(Dashboard{User: "admin", Revenue: 15000})
}

func handlerSettings(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte("<html><body>Settings page</body></html>"))
}
